job.title: Senior Product Owner Mobile App (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: Senior Product Owner Mobile App – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your Product Owner role needs someone who translates customer needs into a backlog the team can deliver – my daily work between business and development on commerce platforms for 5+ years. What I bring in concrete terms:

– User stories, acceptance criteria and stakeholder management
– Headless APIs for storefronts and PWA frontends
– Agile delivery with PI Planning, Jira and UAT

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Product Owner Digital Commerce | Requirements, User Stories & Headless APIs
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years on large B2B and B2C commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Owns the path from requirement to release: business requirements analysis, user stories and acceptance criteria, stakeholder management, process mapping and UAT in agile teams with PI Planning, Jira and Confluence. Brings hands-on technical depth in headless OCC REST APIs for storefronts and PWA frontends, catalog, promotions and order flows, and uses AI tools extensively in analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Deichmann is Europe's largest shoe retailer, and its app is a key channel to millions of customers. I want to bring my commerce platform and requirements experience to a product with that reach, where clear priorities and solid APIs directly shape the customer experience. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your Senior Product Owner Mobile App role caught my eye: 5+ years between business and dev on commerce platforms, user stories, PI Planning, headless/PWA APIs. Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Senior Product Owner Mobile App
en.hook: A Product Owner for a mobile commerce app has to turn customer needs into a clear backlog and make sure the APIs behind the app deliver. That combination is my strength: for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have worked between business and development on large commerce platforms – including the headless APIs that power storefronts and PWA frontends.

bullets.label: Backlog & user stories
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Stakeholder management
bullets.text: Gathered business requirements with product owners and business teams, mapped processes and supported UAT in agile delivery with PI Planning.

bullets.label: App-ready commerce APIs
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends.

bullets.label: Release & quality
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds in agile DevOps workflows and supported production troubleshooting.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to discuss in a conversation how I can help move the Deichmann app forward.
